images.title: Mother, her sister, her daughter
images.purpose: Show the chain you, your mother, her only sister and her daughter, with one numbered link at a time, and the final relation: your mother's only sister's daughter is your cousin sister.
images.composition: A square of four name boxes: two sisters on the top row and you and the daughter below them, joined by two highlighted links and a dashed line carrying the final relation.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Four rounded rectangles, each 320 px wide and 120 px high with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px), text in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px) centred inside. TOP ROW (centres at y 200): box 1 at centre x 330 filled white with the text Your mother; box 2 at centre x 1126 filled white with the text Her only sister and under it, inside the box, the text (your aunt) in regular weight (30 px). BOTTOM ROW (centres at y 580): box 3 at centre x 330 filled reddish purple #CC79A7 with the text You; box 4 at centre x 1126 filled white with the text Her daughter. LINKS: link 1, a thick teal #0072B2 arrow (8 px) from the right edge of box 1 (x 490) to the left edge of box 2 (x 966) at y 200, arrowhead at box 2, with the text link 1 above it (36 px, about y 160, centred at x 728). Link 2, a thick amber #E69F00 arrow (8 px) from the bottom edge of box 2 (y 260) down to the top edge of box 4 (y 520) at x 1126, arrowhead at box 4, with the text link 2 to the right of it (36 px, left edge at x 1160, about y 390). A thin grey #6B7280 straight line (4 px, no arrowhead, no text) from the bottom edge of box 1 to the top edge of box 3 at x 330. A dashed reddish purple line (6 px) from the right edge of box 3 (x 490) to the left edge of box 4 (x 966) at y 580, with the text cousin sister above it (bold, 48 px, dark, centred at x 728, about y 535). Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any person or box beyond the four stated, or a grandparent drawn
link 1 and link 2 swapped or drawn in the same colour
images.takeaway: Take one link at a time: your mother, her only sister, then her daughter, who is your cousin sister.
images.description: Four boxes: Your mother and Her only sister on top joined by link 1, You and Her daughter below, with link 2 from the sister down to her daughter and a dashed line from You to Her daughter marked cousin sister.
images.context: Concept image for Fun with Relations: One Link at a Time. It follows the idea of the figure in your maths book (a family relation read as links between people) and shows the concept's own example, your mother's only sister's daughter.
images.teaching_notes: Say each link aloud before moving on: mother, her sister, her sister's daughter. The slip to watch is skipping a link or starting from the wrong person, so always start from yourself.

image_decisions.why: The chain of four boxes with numbered links makes reading a relation one link at a time visible.
